heading: Today
text: Morning fog burning off to mostly sunny skies. Highs from the mid to upper 70s, nearing 80 in the warmest valleys. Light northwest wind.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear, with a few clouds moving in overnight. Patchy valley fog developing before dawn. Lows in the low to mid 50s, a few 40s in the cooler valleys. Light and variable wind.

heading: Sunday
text: Morning fog burning off to partly sunny skies, then clouds quickly moving in from the west, with rain showers to follow. Highs in the mid to upper 70s, nearing 80 in the warmer valleys. Light south wind.
